name: @ooopsstudio/ooops-ui
description: Accessible, design-neutral UI controllers with Astro 7 and Svelte 5 adapters.

scripts.typecheck: pnpm build && pnpm -r --filter './packages/*' run typecheck && pnpm -r --filter './tests/apps/*' run typecheck
scripts.lint: eslint --cache --cache-strategy content --cache-location .cache/eslint --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern .dependency-cruiser.cjs commitlint.config.mjs eslint.config.js playwright.config.ts vitest.config.ts "scripts/**/*.{js,mjs,cjs,ts,tsx}" "examples/**/*.{js,mjs,cjs,ts,tsx}" "packages/*/*.{js,mjs,cjs,ts,tsx}" "packages/*/{src,test}/**/*.{js,mjs,cjs,ts,tsx}" "tests/**/*.{js,mjs,cjs,ts,tsx}"
scripts.test:e2e:prepare: node scripts/generate-scene-test-fixture.mjs && pnpm build && pnpm --filter @ooopsstudio/ui-e2e-astro build && pnpm --filter @ooopsstudio/ui-e2e-sveltekit build
scripts.test:e2e:run:primitives: playwright test --project=primitives-chromium && playwright test --project=primitives-firefox && playwright test --project=primitives-webkit
scripts.test:e2e:run:astro: playwright test --project=astro-chromium && playwright test --project=astro-firefox && playwright test --project=astro-webkit
scripts.test:e2e:run:svelte: playwright test --project=svelte-chromium && playwright test --project=svelte-firefox && playwright test --project=svelte-webkit
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm test:e2e:prepare && pnpm test:e2e:run:primitives && pnpm test:e2e:run:astro && pnpm test:e2e:run:svelte
scripts.test:e2e:chromium: pnpm test:e2e:prepare && playwright test --project=primitives-chromium && playwright test --project=astro-chromium && playwright test --project=svelte-chromium
scripts.test:e2e:cross-browser: pnpm test:e2e:prepare && playwright test --project=primitives-firefox && playwright test --project=primitives-webkit && playwright test --project=astro-firefox && playwright test --project=astro-webkit && playwright test --project=svelte-firefox && playwright test --project=svelte-webkit
scripts.validate: pnpm guard:template && pnpm check:agents && pnpm check:manifests && pnpm check:optional-modules && pnpm check:licenses && pnpm check:feature-coverage && pnpm check:at-protocol && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm size && pnpm depcruise && pnpm publint && pnpm attw && pnpm check:packed-artifacts && pnpm readiness:strict && pnpm smoke:package-tools
scripts.validate:release: pnpm validate && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm test:e2e:visual && pnpm test:e2e:stress
